summary: Risk appetite is mixed but crypto sentiment is skewed bullish on dip-buying in BTC, while macro shock risk from the Israel-Iran headlines is keeping traders selective. Gold is broadly bullish in institutional outlooks, Brent/oil is more bearish on medium-term forecasts, and several altcoins remain unsupported by fresh TODAY coverage in the sources available.
